reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Repair-time versus timer study, followed by RAD9-state assays, forced activation/degradation and conditional discovery.

checks.quote: Artificial inactivation
checks.reason: The acute-degron and forced-activation causal arms lack explicit matched trigger-only/nondegradable controls and verification that the manipulation preserves initial lesions and general division competence. Foundational sham/external-delay controls do not cover those distinct interventions.

The central repair/conditional-switch/damage-assay technologies and operating conditions remain unspecified without a concrete tool-selection and quantitative calibration-to-execution procedure. Qualitative validation gates do not make the proposed main intervention directly executable.

Damage/measurement calibration names background, dynamic range or controls but does not supply quantitative acceptance thresholds or a concrete procedure to derive tolerances and act on failed calibration.

checks.quote: first bud emergence
checks.reason: Bud emergence is not completed division or necessarily the delayed transition; choosing it or nuclear division without mapping the actual checkpoint transition can miss the target phenotype. Repair foci/survival are also offered without a required direct-lesion calibration.

checks.quote: 80% power at alpha 0.05
checks.reason: Pilot variance and power are named, but no meaningful time-delay effect/precision target is selected; the later correlation r>0.7 concerns a different endpoint and does not complete the primary culture-size calculation.

checks.quote: cells already budded, dead, lost from field
checks.reason: Dead cells and tracking losses are listed as exclusions without a pre-treatment restriction, all-assigned denominator or sensitivity policy; post-treatment deaths are outcomes, not removable technical failures.

checks.quote: Kaplan-Meier, Cox proportional hazards
checks.reason: No competing-death/nested repeated-culture implementation, proportional-hazard checks or multiple-comparison procedure is specified.

Dose/duration/switch parameters are described as a range or to be calibrated without a bounded ladder or a concrete range-derivation and acceptance-to-lock procedure. This differs from independent assay calibration in P03.
Troubleshooting and pilot separation are present, but no explicit change-control policy requires re-freezing the revised procedure and fresh independent confirmation after technical changes.

checks.quote: no significant correlation for timer
checks.reason: Nonsignificant repair/division correlation does not establish a timer. Similarly, failure to release after an inducible degradation command does not show initiation-only RAD9 without verified acute functional depletion and adequate null precision.

checks.quote: repair foci, damage-sensitive gel electrophoresis, or survival
checks.reason: The plan treats these as alternatives without mandatory independent calibration of a physical repair endpoint; survival/focus disappearance cannot establish lesion removal. The causal interpretation needs a validated orthogonal repair/state measure.
Raw movie/lineage/assay identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and source-to-output records sufficient to reconstruct the study are not specified as a complete audit trail.

explanation_reason: A valid alternative direction and useful provenance/controls, but causal intervention controls, division/repair endpoint validity and nonsignificance-to-timer reasoning are incomplete.
historical_match_reason: The primary question concerns repair-state versus timer control and temporal RAD9 requirement. It does not ask whether checkpoint initiation AND recovery require new protein synthesis, nor propose verified translation inhibition with corresponding drug controls and both switching readouts. These are scientifically legitimate alternative directions, but none of the five specific synthesis-versus-existing-protein historical components is supplied. Q2 is assessed separately.
